biotools.summary: XASDB is a database and toolkit for experimental X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) data, offering spectrum visualization, data processing, spectrum matching, and downloading capabilities. It provides tools for data normalization, searching, and sharing data with other XAS databases and users.
